[Package]
Name="jki_state_machine_editor"
Version="2024.0.3.6"
Release=""
ID=d526478a148820a9017cb10b6246a50b
File Format="vip"
Format Version="2017"
Display Name="JKI State Machine Editor"


[Description]
Description="Makes working with the JKI State Machine very easy.\0D\0A\0D\0AHow to use:\0D\0A\0D\0ALaunching the Tool via Right-Click\0D\0A1) Right-click on a State String, Case Structure, or Event Structure to launch JKI SM Editor\0D\0A\0D\0ALaunching the Tool via QuickDrop:\0D\0A1) Select a Case Structure or Event Structure\0D\0A2) Press Control+Space then Control+J\0D\0A3) Enjoy increased productivity working with your Case/Event structure\0D\0A\0D\0AUsing the Tool:\0D\0A- Select an item in the tree to make that fram visible\0D\0A- Click back and forward to navigate the history\0D\0A- Drag and drop frames to reorganize the order\0D\0A- Right-click on items in the tree-view to rename, duplicate, delete, etc.\0D\0A- Right-click on a state string and choose Goto State Frame to jump to that frame of the JKI SM.\0A- Right click on a state string or frame and choose Find Callers to find all callers of a state\0A- Right-click on a bundle or unbundle by name and choose Find Data Accessors to find all accessors of the data.\0D\0A\0D\0ASpecial thanks to Jim Carmody for open sourcing his CaseSelect tool as a launching off point for the JKI SM Editor."
Summary="Select a Case or Event structure and Ctrl+Space then Ctrl+J to launch the JKI SM Helper"
License="BSD"
Copyright="Copyright (c) 2017, JKI, jcarmody"
Distribution=""
Vendor="JKI"
URL="https://github.com/JKISoftware/JKI-State-Machine-Editor"
Packager="JKI"
Demo="FALSE"
Release Notes="- Added compatibility to LabVIEW 2024 Q3\0A- Fixed Right Click Menu reference race condition\0A- Updated codebase to LabVIEW 2020\0A- Optimized launching speed\0A- Added JKI State Machine 2024 support"
